name: Eiren
source:
The noble and beautiful princess of the elves.
She is respected as a leader because of her love for her people.
On the other hand, she has a biased view of elves as a higher race and humans as lower-class.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1243618
